target: Paisaje de navegación de Piedra del Viento Verde en el Paso del Dosel Alto.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Formación natural donde aire frío de Hoshai entra en el bosque de Nhal; debe comunicar cambio de humedad, luz y altura.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape of the canonical Piedra del Viento Verde. A distinctive but entirely natural gray rock formation stands on a rising forested route where cold mountain air enters Nhal. Dense wet trunks and roots dominate the lower foreground, but wind bends leaves and exposes patches of cooler bare rock; through a constrained opening, higher Hoshai slopes are visible. The landmark should feel useful for orientation because vegetation and airflow visibly change around it. Cool pale daylight, deep greens, wet bark, blue-gray stone.
negative_constraints: No carved standing stone, shrine, runes or monument
No magical green wind, glow or energy
No characters or creatures as focal subject
